items.name: Caddoc's Lantern Charm
items.lore: A dented lantern's last glass, set in brass. Carried somewhere, as Caddoc would have liked.

items.name: Hale Family Signet
items.lore: Maren Hale's father's ring, meant for her brother.

items.name: Tombwalker's Girdle
items.lore: Taken from the Tomb of Mithra, where Caddoc Hale went singing.

items.name: Mantle of the Kind Lie
items.lore: Maren keeps his supper warm. Some kindnesses weigh more than truth.

items.name: Weaver's Hopeful Mantle
items.lore: Woven by Ysolde Marchant the night her son came home.

items.name: Three-Note Band
items.lore: Silver, cold, and humming three notes no one sings any more.

items.name: Waystone Bracer
items.lore: Cut from the north road's waystone, where the pilgrims' boot-prints ended.

items.name: Shepherd's Lucky Charm
items.lore: An old shepherd's charm. He said you'd need it more than him.

items.name: Sheep-Song Sash
items.lore: Woven with the shepherd's tune - the sheep still follow it.

items.name: Bell-Wether's Favour
items.lore: A faerie promise in silver. Faeries keep their promises better than most people.
